description: Defines the AddressList class for managing collections of IP endpoints and DNS aliases, including methods for creation, comparison, and serialization.

classes.name: AddressList
classes.description: Manages a list of IP endpoints and DNS aliases, with methods for creation, comparison, and serialization.

methods.name: CreateFromIPAddress
methods.description: Creates an AddressList from a single IPAddress and port.

methods.name: CreateFromIPAddressList
methods.description: Creates an AddressList from a list of IPAddress objects and DNS aliases.

methods.name: CreateFromAddrinfo
methods.description: Creates an AddressList from addrinfo chain.

methods.name: CopyWithPort
methods.description: Returns a copy of an AddressList with all endpoints set to a specified port.

methods.name: SetDefaultCanonicalName
methods.description: Sets the first DNS alias to the literal of the first IP address.

methods.name: NetLogParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary for logging the address list.

methods.name: Deduplicate
methods.description: Removes duplicate addresses while preserving order.
